card.title: 957. VOLKSGRENADIER
card.text: Deployment: Add a PRODUCTION to your hand.
card.flavorText: The 957th Volksgrenadier Regiment was a unit of the 363rd Volksgrenadier Division of the German Wehrmacht during WWII, active from 1944 to 1945. The division was created in September 1944 by renaming the 566th Volksgrenadier Division, thus replacing the original 363rd Infantry Division which had been destroyed in the Falaise Pocket. The division was commanded by August Dettling and included the 957th, 958th and 959th Grenadier Regiments, as well as the 363rd Artillery Regiment. The division first saw action in the Netherlands, where it suffered heavy losses during a failed German attack near Nijmegen in October 1944. After being re-equipped, it fought along the Roer River before being encircled and destroyed in the Ruhr Pocket in April 1945.
